description: Shifts a 1V/octave pitch by an interval, given either as a whole-number ratio or in cents, by a whole number of those intervals plus a fraction of one

params.text: Sets the top number of the interval ratio, 1 to 9999999; the shift in volts is the base-two logarithm of this over the bottom number
Sets the bottom number of the interval ratio, 1 to 9999999
Sets the interval in cents, -9999.9 to 9999.9, where 1200 cents is an octave
Sets a fraction of one interval to add, -1 to +1, multiplied by the voltage at the bend CV jack
Sets a whole number of intervals to add, -9999 to +9999, multiplied by the voltage at the transpose CV jack
Chooses whether the interval is taken from the ratio or from the cents value

inputs.text: The pitch to be shifted, at 1V per octave
Multiplies the BEND setting: ±5V here maps to -1 to +1, and with nothing patched the setting counts in full
Multiplies the TRANSPOSE setting: ±5V here maps to -1 to +1, and with nothing patched the setting counts in full

outputs.text: The pitch at the input passed on unchanged

notes: the two CV jacks multiply rather than add, so 0V at either holds that amount at zero and an unpatched jack counts as one
a polyphonic cable at either CV jack uses only its first channel for every channel of the pitch
the number of the channels at the pitch input sets the channel count of both outputs
the small display under the transpose figure reads out the transpose amount after the CV has multiplied it

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 1, which is full scale.
inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 1, which is full scale.
